subject: Power analysis for current statistical result

messages.author: b87912786badc8a7
messages.subject: Power analysis for current statistical result
parts:
Hello,

I am wondering if it would be appropriate to use the power analysis command to determine the power of the current analyzed experiment. Since the power analysis uses the parameters of the current experiment to predict for a future experiment, is the power analysis result telling us the power of the current experiment?

If so, we would then have to consider where the logFC cutoff is (according to the desired power) for truly confident significance results, correct?

Also, if an experiment has an unbalanced design (2 groups; 5 BioReps and 4 BioReps), would we have to insert 4 for "NumSample" to determine the the other factors?

Thank you,

Frank
